scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,app -c blue,green "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:app"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n api,app,electron -c blue,green,magenta "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:app" "sleep 3 && cd apps/desktop && PROSODEUS_DEV_URL=http://localhost:5173 bun run dev"
scripts.dev:desktop:debug: concurrently -k -n api,app,electron -c blue,green,magenta "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:app" "sleep 3 && cd apps/desktop && PROSODEUS_DEV_URL=http://localhost:5173 bun run dev:debug"
scripts.dev:stop: sh -c 'for port in 5173 8788; do pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:$port -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill $pids 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done'
scripts.dev:reset: rm -rf apps/worker/.dev-data apps/app/node_modules/.vite apps/app/node_modules/.vite-temp && echo 'Dev state cleared'
